GROMACS

Accelerate Bench task · Molecular simulation & electronic structure

GROMACS runs molecular dynamics simulations of interacting particles.

Task version12.1.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory6 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

The supplied water and argon systems evolve under prescribed interaction models, integration steps and output schedules.

Correctness

The trajectories, energies and final particle state must agree with the reference, and replaying a simulation must reproduce its trajectories and energies.

Timing

Timing covers the complete mdrun simulation. Compilation and input preparation take place before the clock starts.
